answer_1.quote: Grammatical error correction (GEC) is the task of automatically editing text to remove grammatical errors...
answer_1.outputs: corrected sentences with minimal edits to fix grammatical errors

answer_2.quote: Performance is evaluated using the F 0.5 metric calculated by ERRANT.

answer_4.quote: The data is corrected for errors by two expert annotators, trained for correcting grammatical errors in English text...
